description: MyEnergyStats is the national energy statistics portal of the Energy Commission of Malaysia (Suruhanjaya Tenaga), which replaced the Malaysia Energy Information Hub (meih.st.gov.my now redirects to it). It aims to be a national energy database for local and international users. Its Energy Database pages give system generation and demand figures for Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah and Sarawak (for Peninsular Malaysia in 2025: highest demand 21,049 MW on 28 May 2025, installed capacity 27,333 MW, reserve margin 29%), a Sankey summary of the national energy balance for 2024, lists of licensees (independent power producers, co-generation, renewable energy, large-scale solar, electricity distributors) and the electricity tariffs of the utilities, including Sabah Electricity (SESB) and Sarawak Energy. Topic pages cover oil, natural gas, coal, electricity, renewable energy and new energy technology, with an interactive statistics dashboard. Coverage is national by region; resolution is annual national or regional aggregates. Format and access: web dashboard and tables with downloadable documents; some features ask users to register or log in. Licence: portal terms of use; content is copyright of the Energy Commission. Free. Caveats: detailed series sit behind the dashboard, and some regional figures carry stale date labels. Simulation uses: demand and capacity inputs for power system planning and energy balance scenarios for Malaysia. Related records: complements OpenDOSM water supply statistics and the MCMC Facts and Figures in the catalogue.
